note: 0.1.13: the status line's shim (CACHE-05) checks its launcher before it runs it: with that copy gone (uninstalled, pruned, a failed update) it exits 0 and prints nothing, so a status line that calls it shows an empty segment instead of sh errors on every refresh. With the launcher there it is still one exec, arguments and stdin passed through. A shim of the earlier form (no check) pointing at this same copy is rewritten to the new form at the next SessionStart.

steps.name: an earlier shim (no check) to this same copy: rewritten with the check

contains:
#!/bin/sh
# $BRAND: a fixed path to the installed plugin's helper, for status lines (README: the cache state in your status line); kept by its SessionStart hook.
[ -x '$STORE' ] || exit 0
exec '$STORE' "$@"

steps.name: the same again: left as it is
the launcher there: one exec, arguments and stdin passed through
the launcher gone: exit 0, nothing on stdout or stderr
and under sh, as a status line command runs it
the launcher back: it runs again
